column1: #mapping_set_title: Dispute Workbench screen to the payments ontology (illustrative)

#mapping_set_description: "Illustrative: the disputes team's screen for one chargeback case, in the same made-up React app, Spring backend and GraphQL data API as the transaction research screen. Written by the deep scan (web/scripts/lineage-scan.ts) from the made-up repositories in examples/lineage/; every system, file, table, column and line of code is invented. Two kinds of row: a field prov:wasDerivedFrom the field it is built from, with how (transform) and the code that does it, and a field's meaning in the ontology. fabric: names an ontology class's slot as the studio writes it, Class.slot."
